# Overview

`TG_Score()` performs target gene enrichment analysis by testing whether
a pathway's genes are located unexpectedly toward one end of a ranked
gene list. The ranked list is restricted to the target genes of
differentially expressed miRNAs, mapped through `background_MGI`, and
ranked by each gene's own differential expression statistic. This is a
GSEA style test, built on `r BiocStyle::Biocpkg("clusterProfiler")`'s
`GSEA()`.

This vignette uses the same toy BLCA example data as the package's main
Quick Start vignette. See `vignette("miREA")` for a description of that
data and for running all nine methods together through `miREA()`.

# Required inputs

* `pathway`, a two column data frame with columns `pathway` and `gene`.
* `mir_DEdata`, a four column data frame with columns `miRNA`,
  `log2FoldChange`, `stat`, and `padj`.
* `gene_DEdata`, a four column data frame with columns `gene`,
  `log2FoldChange`, `stat`, and `padj`.
* `background_MGI`, a two column data frame with columns `miRNA` and
  `gene`, or `NULL` to use the bundled default (see `vignette("miREA")`,
  Step 1, for details on `background_MGI`).
* `pvalueType` for `TG_Score()` itself, one of `"pos"`, `"neg"`, or
  `"std"`, selecting a one sided or two sided test.

```{r load-data}
library(miREA)
data(toy_pathway)
data(toy_mir_DEdata)
data(toy_gene_DEdata)
data(background_MGI)
```

# Run TG-Score

```{r prepare-input}
input_data <- getAllInputData(
    methods = "TG_Score",
    pathway = toy_pathway,
    mir_DEdata = toy_mir_DEdata,
    gene_DEdata = toy_gene_DEdata,
    background_MGI = background_MGI
)
```

`input_data$data$TG_Score` holds the ranked gene list, restricted to the
target genes of differentially expressed miRNAs and ranked by each gene's
own differential expression statistic. `input_data$pathway$TG` holds the
pathway gene sets, unchanged from the `toy_pathway` input.

```{r run-tg-score}
res <- TG_Score(
    geneList = input_data$data$TG_Score,
    pathway = input_data$pathway$TG,
    pvalueType = "std",
    pvalueCutoff = 1
)
head(res)
```

# Run through miREA()

`TG_Score()` can also be run through the `miREA()` wrapper, which is
useful when you want its result alongside other methods' results in a
single `miREAResult` object (see `vignette("miREA")`, Step 2, for the
multi-method case). `TG_Score()` itself has no `background` argument, but
`miREA()` still requires one for the `TG` target, since `TG_ORA()` shares
that target and does use it. For a single target, `background` can be a
plain character vector instead of a named list.

```{r run-through-miREA}
result <- miREA(
    methods = "TG_Score",
    input_data = input_data,
    background = unique(toy_pathway$gene),
    pvalueCutoff = 1
)
head(result$result$TG_Score)
```

# Supplying your own ranked gene list

`TG_Score()`'s real input is a ranked list of genes targeted by miRNAs of
interest, not an arbitrary ranked gene list. If you already have a miRNA
list from an external analysis instead of letting `getAllInputData()`
derive one from `mir_DEdata`, map that miRNA list to its target genes
through `background_MGI`, the same step `getAllInputData()` performs
internally, then rank those genes by their own differential expression
statistic from `gene_DEdata`.

```{r custom-list, eval=FALSE}
# replace with your own miRNA list
my_miRs <- c("hsa-miR-21-5p", "hsa-miR-155-5p")
my_TG <- unique(background_MGI$gene[background_MGI$miRNA %in% my_miRs])
my_geneList <- toy_gene_DEdata$stat[match(my_TG, toy_gene_DEdata$gene)]
names(my_geneList) <- my_TG
my_geneList <- sort(my_geneList[!is.na(my_geneList)], decreasing = TRUE)
res_custom <- TG_Score(
    geneList = my_geneList,
    pathway = toy_pathway,
    pvalueType = "std",
    pvalueCutoff = 1
)
```
